title: What program are we a part of

classification.theory_summary: Author suggests many people share the same recurring 'mall world' dream places and asks who is 'conducting' it (experiment/program/mind control/spiritual warfare), describing feeling observed and tortured in dreams.
classification.question_topic: Who is conducting/controlling the shared 'Mall World' experience; is it an experiment/program and how to get out

meta.initial_emotion: annoyed about having no control anymore; often unsettled
meta.final_emotion: wants out; feels strongly opposed/defiant; distressed
meta.author_theory: Believes the recurring shared 'mall world' dreams may involve being controlled/observed as part of a program/experiment; asks others for theories.

qualities.raw_description: “I always go to the mall world every night for years.” “It's often unsettling, and I feel like it's a mind prison.” “I get the feeling of constantly being observed, watched and looked over.”

interactions.description: Dreamer reports feeling constantly observed/watched while in 'mall world'.

entities_involved.description: Unseen observer(s); described as being “constantly… observed, watched and looked over.”

interactions.description: Dreamer reports being “constantly tortured” in dreams and having experienced “torture” they could not fathom in waking life.
